verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that llamafile supports GGUF models and bundles the runtime with the weights in one file. Nothing in the pack documents a compatibility policy, versioning guarantees, or upgrade notes on whether newer runtime versions can break previously downloaded quantized model files. The axis applies to a model runtime, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
